Design Decisions

This section contains Architecture Decision Records (ADRs) and design documents for the Deep Research Engine.

Design Decisions

Engine State Design

Decision: Use a generic 18-field TypedDict instead of workflow-specific state classes.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardPrevious implementations had 50+ field state classes
  • arrow_forwardMost fields were unused by specific workflows
  • arrow_forwardGeneric state with context dict for workflow-specific data
  • arrow_forwardEasier to maintain and understand

Base Worker Design

Decision: All workers inherit from BaseWorker ABC with standardized interface.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardUniform contract: execute(state, config) -> WorkerResult
  • arrow_forwardBuilt-in helpers for timing, error handling, retry
  • arrow_forwardEasy to add new workers via registry
  • arrow_forwardConsistent error handling across all workers

Package Structure

Decision: Clean package structure with clear separation of concerns.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardsrc/deep_research_engine/ - Main package
  • arrow_forwardconfigs/ - Workflow configurations
  • arrow_forwardshared-docs/ - Centralized documentation
  • arrow_forwardEasy to navigate and maintain

Pluggable Storage Design

Decision: Storage backends are pluggable via registry pattern.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardDifferent workflows need different storage
  • arrow_forwardPDF summarizer: Just in-memory
  • arrow_forwardTelegram: Postgres + Neo4j + MongoDB + MinIO
  • arrow_forwardEasy to add new backends
  • arrow_forwardUniform interface via StorageBackend ABC

Unified Config Schema

Decision: Single YAML schema for all workflow types.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardNew workflow = new YAML config
  • arrow_forwardNo code changes needed for new workflows
  • arrow_forwardEnvironment variable interpolation with ${VAR} syntax
  • arrow_forwardSchema validation on load

Workflow Migration

Decision: Migrate 4 existing projects to unified engine.

Rationale:

  • arrow_forwardAll projects use same Boss → Workers → Critic → Synthesis pattern
  • arrow_forwardEliminate code duplication
  • arrow_forwardCentralized maintenance
  • arrow_forwardConsistent user experience
architecture

Architecture Principles

  1. arrow_forwardSimplicity - 18 fields max, not 50+
  2. arrow_forwardPluggability - Storage, workers, tools via registry
  3. arrow_forwardConfig-Driven - New workflow = new YAML
  4. arrow_forwardType Safety - TypedDict, mypy validation
  5. arrow_forwardInfrastructure Integration - Deep integration with shared-docker-infra
